results.title: The fake commute: How China's unemployed save face
results.description: Unemployed individuals in China are pretending to be employed to avoid family concerns about their jobless situation. Many are sharing tips online about how to navigate daily life while hiding their unemployment status. This behavior reflects the challenges posed by a struggling economy and increased job competition. As some individuals receive unemployment benefits, societal pressure from family members adds to their anxiety.

results.title: 27 Fake Profiles, 82 Victims: Posing as a Woman Online, Hyderabad Man Arrested for Allegedly Extorting Rs 25.16 Lakh
results.description: A 23-year-old man was arrested in Hyderabad for allegedly extorting over Rs 25 lakh from victims using fake female social media profiles. By posing as a woman named Chandana, he lured individuals into sharing private photos and videos, which he then used to blackmail them.
